product.tagline: 在本机快速生成、识别、复制和导出二维码。
product.description: 提供轻量二维码生成与识别工作流，支持 PNG 导出、拖拽和粘贴识别、链接打开、最近记录以及可脚本化的 JSON CLI。
nonGoals: 上传二维码内容到第三方服务
替代专业条码扫描设备或批量管理平台
在没有用户操作的情况下读取剪贴板或打开链接

capabilities.title: 生成二维码
capabilities.body: 输入文本或测试链接，立即生成二维码并导出 PNG。

capabilities.title: 图片识别
capabilities.body: 通过文件选择、拖拽或粘贴截图识别二维码内容。

capabilities.title: 复制与打开
capabilities.body: 识别结果可以复制；当内容是链接时，可由用户确认后打开。

capabilities.title: 最近记录
capabilities.body: 在本机保留最近生成和识别记录，支持单条删除与一键清空。

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: 通过 info、capabilities、encode 和 decode 输出稳定 JSON，适合自动化。

workflow.label: 输入
workflow.title: 填写文本或选择图片
workflow.body: 输入测试内容生成二维码，或选择用户明确提供的图片进行识别。

workflow.label: 处理
workflow.title: 生成或识别
workflow.body: 查看二维码预览或识别结果，确认内容是否符合预期。

workflow.label: 使用
workflow.title: 复制、导出或打开
workflow.body: 将结果复制到剪贴板、导出 PNG，或在链接场景下由用户确认后打开。

workflow.label: 清理
workflow.title: 管理本机历史
workflow.body: 按需删除单条记录或清空最近历史，避免示例数据长期保留。

boundary.title: 二维码内容由用户明确提供
boundary.body: rQrcode 在本机生成和识别二维码，不要求上传服务。截图与文档只使用 example.test、demo 文本等测试数据，不包含真实联系人、账号或个人链接。

website.releaseSummary: 首个公开预览版覆盖二维码生成、PNG 导出、图片识别、剪贴板工作流、最近历史和稳定 JSON CLI。

product.tagline: Generate, decode, copy, and export QR codes locally.
product.description: A lightweight local workflow for QR generation and decoding with PNG export, drag-and-drop or clipboard input, link opening, recent history, and a scriptable JSON CLI.
nonGoals: Upload QR content to a third-party service
Replace specialist scanning hardware or a batch management platform
Read the clipboard or open links without an explicit user action

capabilities.title: Generate QR codes
capabilities.body: Enter text or a test link, preview the QR code, and export it as PNG.

capabilities.title: Decode images
capabilities.body: Decode QR content from a selected file, dragged image, or pasted screenshot.

capabilities.title: Copy and open
capabilities.body: Copy decoded content, or ask the user before opening a decoded link.

capabilities.title: Recent items
capabilities.body: Keep recent generated and decoded items locally with single-item delete and clear-all controls.

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: Use stable JSON info, capabilities, encode, and decode commands in automation.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.title: Enter text or choose an image
workflow.body: Generate from test content or decode an explicitly selected image.

workflow.label: Process
workflow.title: Generate or decode
workflow.body: Review the QR preview or decoded result before using it.

workflow.label: Use
workflow.title: Copy, export, or open
workflow.body: Copy the result, export PNG, or explicitly confirm before opening a link.

workflow.label: Clean up
workflow.title: Manage local history
workflow.body: Delete one item or clear recent history when sample data is no longer needed.

boundary.title: QR content is explicitly supplied by the user
boundary.body: rQrcode generates and decodes QR codes locally without an upload service. Its screenshots and documentation use example.test and demo text only, with no real contacts, accounts, or personal links.

website.releaseSummary: The first public preview covers QR generation, PNG export, image decoding, clipboard workflows, recent history, and a stable JSON CLI.
